title: Record per-test gate durations and run independent test cases concurrently
outcome: The full gate records per-test durations and its slowest tests, combines the existing scale selections, and runs independent notes, operation-matrix and diagnostics cases concurrently without losing coverage.
acceptance: The full gate records per-test durations and lists the slowest tests; unsupported timing is reported visibly without rerunning tests or changing their verdicts
Every existing gate check, test assertion and scale budget is retained when the scale phases are combined and independent test cases are split
